name: ShowSky_3
short_caption: The robot raises its left arm to point upward and outward with an open hand, then returns to its neutral pose.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and raises its left arm sideways and upward in a smooth arc. As the arm reaches its highest point, the hand is fully opened with the palm facing forward and upward, pointing toward the upper-right space. After a brief pause at the peak of the gesture, the robot gently lowers the left arm back to its side, returning to the neutral starting position.
safety_notes: The left arm sweeps outward to the side; ensure there are no obstacles close to the robot's left side.
